{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ord Trasi salvage yards''' was located near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Trasi/Legends|Ord Trasi]].

==History==
The yards were used to dump decommissioned [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. The [[Core Galaxy Systems]] [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] [[Enforcer One (dreadnaught)|''Enforcer One'']] was salvaged here by the gangster [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
